Value: Helios Towers plc, an independent tower company, acquires, builds, and operates telecommunications towers. The company offers colocation lease-up, build-to-suit, sale and leaseback, in-building, small cells/outdoor distributed antenna systems, and other managed services. It also provides passive infrastructure solutions, including site selection and preparation, maintenance, security, and power management; and engages in hosting of active equipment, such as antennae. The company operates a network of sites and tenancies in Tanzania, Senegal, Malawi, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Congo Brazzaville, South Africa, Ghana, Madagascar, and Oman. Helios Towers plc was founded in 2009 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
